purpose: Manual golden baselines for regression-critical real sites. These files are source-of-truth visual references for extension output review, not broad always-on visual tests for all 100 sites.
usage: Use a golden baseline when a listed site lands in 01-LOOK-FIRST-engine-risk or UNSTABLE SITE after an engine/QA change.
Use a golden baseline before closing a bug class that was found by manual review on that site.
Do not run golden-baseline comparison for every user capture or every 100-site run by default.
Do not add baselines for all 100 sites; keep this set to the highest-risk 10-20 sites and prefer detector fixtures for general bug classes.
